name: Asakuma Co.,Ltd
summary: Asakuma Co.,Ltd engages in the restaurant management and franchise businesses in Japan. It operates restaurants under the Steak no Asakuma brand name; Motsuyaki Izakaya under the Ebisu San brand name; Indonesian-style Izakaya under the Wayang Bali brand name; Indonesian restaurant under the Surabaya brand name; and curry specialty restaurant under the Curry no Asaku brand name. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Nisshin, Japan. Asakuma Co.,Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Tempos Holdings Co., Ltd.
